text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Thank you both so much for the birthday 
presents~!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"That's a suuuuper cute headband!! The 
embroidered konpeito candy accent is 
adorable!"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ah~... um. To be honest, that was supposed 
to be cherry blossoms... Sorry, I couldn't 
make it turn out well...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Then that embroidery... Could 
City-san have made it by hand...!?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
City was working hard late into the night! 
She failed sometimes, but she never gave 
up!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...You're one to talk, Bamboo-senpai. 
Didn't you go to a bunch of shops looking 
for fabric to make the perfect headband 
for Chiyo?"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
And it was totally worth the effort—I 
found the perfect one! It's a gorgeous 
light pink, and the fabric is super soft 
yet really durable!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh! I'm so deeply, truly moved...! That 
headband holds both of your passionate 
feelings...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'll cherish and take great care of it! 
I'll hand-wash and iron it every single 
day!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Haha, seeing you so happy makes it all 
worth it.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
This headband is packed with cheers from 
all of us, so please put it to good use!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"I have received your cheer loud and 
clear! 'After the headband, spring shall 
come.' I swear I will bloom in full 
glory!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
So I can catch up to the ones I admire...! 
So I can keep running side by side with 
the two of you!
